meta.note: Round 41. Continues HANDOFF 082 §3's two-layer sweep. THE HEADLINE IS THAT THE SEAM IS NOT A FRAMESET QUIRK: it has now paid on four different publication SHAPES. Guangdong ships the yearbook as a first-party zip, and every chapter directory holds an indicators.html (主要统计指标解释) beside the brief-description.html (简要说明) that four earlier rounds read; nobody had opened one. Suzhou is a frameset and was recorded 'read and empty' after its 编者说明 (an image) and its 20 image-only smNN.pdf were read — its left.htm lists 19 zbNN.pdf beside them, all with clean text layers, and they carry Suzhou's first two edges. The check that finds this is always the same: re-read the TOC and ask which files were never downloaded, not what the previous round's notes concluded. ALSO IN THIS ROUND: the two trade hubs minted in round 40 are wired to Jiangsu (ch14, both in one sentence) and Guangdong (ch16 and ch17, both naming 国家统计局 as the issuer), which was HANDOFF 082 §3 item 2; and 《全国农业普查条例》 is minted off Guangdong ch11, applying round 40's finding that the NBS 重大国情国力普查条例 sub-listing publishes these regulations — the agricultural one sits there beside 全国人口普查条例 and 全国经济普查条例 and was the one with a citing document already in hand. A FETCH TRAP WORTH THE LINE: Guangdong's zip is 21,520,465 bytes and a plain curl truncates it at ~15.2 MB silently; unzip then reports 'End-of-central-directory signature not found', which reads like a corrupt archive rather than a short download. `curl -C -` resumes it. Every quote read live from the cited URL on the live host on 2026-09-09 from the cloud container. ADDENDUM 2026-09-10: Thomas ruled on both parked questions — 三次产业划分规定 is ONE node (the 2012 instrument, 2018 revision in the description) and Guangdong's dated citation is wired; Suzhou → 统计法 is wired as legal_basis, definitional use distinguished from Shandong's publicity mention. Now 13 edges, all A, and 2 nodes.

reports.title: 全国农业普查条例 (Regulations on the National Agricultural Census)
reports.publisher: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The State Council regulation governing China's decennial agricultural census, promulgated in August 2006. It fixes the census on a ten-year cycle in years ending in 6, sets the standard reference point at 24:00 on 31 December of the census year, and defines the census objects (rural households, urban agricultural production households, agricultural production and operation units, villagers' committees and township governments) and its industry scope (crop cultivation, forestry, animal husbandry, fishery and agricultural support activities). Three censuses have been run under or ahead of it — 1996, 2006 and 2016. It is the instrument provincial and national yearbooks name when they explain why their agricultural series were revised on census results rather than carried forward from annual returns. NBS publishes an authoritative account of its main provisions on its own 重大国情国力普查条例 listing, alongside 全国人口普查条例 and 全国经济普查条例; that page is the URL cited here. NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the State Council, not NBS, and the cited page is NBS's 主要内容 exposition rather than the promulgated text — move the URL if a gov.cn full-text page is located.
reports.cadence_note: A standing State Council regulation in force since 2006, not reissued on a cycle; the census it governs runs once every ten years in years ending in 6.

reports.title: 三次产业划分规定（2012） (Provisions on the Division of the Three Industrial Sectors (2012))
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS provision that assigns every 国民经济行业分类 (GB/T 4754) category to the primary, secondary or tertiary sector — the rule behind every 三次产业 split in China's GDP, employment and value-added tables. The 2012 text (根据《国民经济行业分类》（GB/T 4754—2011），制定本规定) defines the three sectors by enumeration and attaches the 门类/大类 mapping. It was REVISED IN PLACE by 国统设管函〔2018〕74号 (国家统计局关于修订《三次产业划分规定（2012）》的通知, 2018-03-23), which re-mapped its categories onto GB/T 4754—2017 and attached a new 三次产业分类; NBS did not retitle it, so this node is the 2012 instrument in its 2018-revised state and the 2018 notice is recorded here rather than as a separate node (Thomas, 2026-09-10). The revising notice: https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202302/t20230213_1902764.html. EDITION RULE FOR CITATIONS: a yearbook that dates its citation to the 2018 revision (Guangdong: 执行国家统计局2018年修订的《三次产业划分规定》) names this node; a BARE 《三次产业划分规定》 with no year (national zb03, Jilin zbjs2, Xi'an zb03, Hunan zb02) remains refused, because it cannot distinguish the 2012 text from its revised state.
reports.cadence_note: A standing NBS statistical standard; 2012 text, revised once by notice in March 2018 to follow GB/T 4754-2017. Not reissued on a cycle.

Node minted in this file; the Guangdong edge is live. Original analysis follows. --- ORIGINAL: AWAITING A RULING, NOT REFUSED — and it is the first citation that is not bare. Guangdong's table 2-2 note reads 2.三次产业分类执行国家统计局2018年修订的《三次产业划分规定》，全省数据修订至1992年。 The standing refusal (national zb03, Jilin zbjs2, Xi'an zb03, and Hunan zb02 read this round) is for a BARE title with no year, on the ground that NBS publishes two candidate pages. THIS ROUND IDENTIFIED WHAT THE TWO PAGES ACTUALLY ARE, and they are not two competing editions: https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202302/t20230213_1902749.html is 《三次产业划分规定（2012）》 itself (its own text: 根据《国民经济行业分类》（GB/T 4754—2011），制定本规定), and https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202302/t20230213_1902764.html is 国统设管函〔2018〕74号 of 2018-03-23, 国家统计局关于修订《三次产业划分规定（2012）》的通知, which re-maps the 2012 regulation's industry categories onto GB/T 4754—2017 and attaches 三次产业分类. So a bare citation is genuinely ambiguous between the 2012 base text and its 2018-revised state, and the earlier refusals were right; Guangdong's dated citation is not ambiguous. THE OPEN QUESTION IS NODE SHAPE, which is why nothing is minted here: one node titled 《三次产业划分规定（2012）》 carrying the 2018 revision, or the 2018 通知 as its own node. Both are defensible and the corpus's edition-per-node habit (GB/T 4754-2017) points one way while §7a's carry-the-publisher's-own-title rule points the other. Thomas to rule. Four yearbooks are waiting on the answer.

RESOLVED 2026-09-10: Thomas ruled wire it — definitional use of the law by a published series is a legal_basis dependency; Shandong's legal-publicity mention was not. Edge live in this file. Same-day sweep of the national, Shandong and Xi'an 人民生活 notes found no second instance. Original follows. --- ORIGINAL: AWAITING A RULING. Suzhou's zb14 (人民生活) 主要统计指标解释 defines the yearbook's own survey unit against the Statistics Law by full title: 依照《中华人民共和国统计法》规定，开展住户收支与生活状况调查的住户为调查户。住户调查对象为中华人民共和国境内的住户… Read live from http://tjj.suzhou.gov.cn/sztjj/tjnj/2025/2025/zk/html/zb14.pdf on 2026-09-09, contiguous on one line. IT WOULD GRADE A ON THE ORDINARY RULES — full title, the release's own indicator definition, a stated basis rather than an alignment claim — and cn-statistics-law is a live node. THE REASON IT IS PARKED: round 40 refused Shandong's 《统计法》 mention as legal-publicity activity rather than a dependency, and the two are close enough that wiring this one without a ruling would set a precedent by accident. The distinction I would draw is that Shandong's sat in an administrative work summary (统计事业发展综述) while this one is definitional and load-bearing for a published series, but that is a rule about a class, not a call about one edge, and PLAYBOOK.md says an unapplied finding awaiting a ruling lives in HANDOFF.md until Thomas has ruled. If it goes live the same sentence shape should be swept for across every yearbook already fetched.

NO EDGE. Guangdong's table 3-8 note names TWO urban/rural instruments with issuer and year — 本表2000年、2005年数据按国家统计局1999年发布的《关于统计上划分城乡的规定(试行)》计算；2006年起数据按国家统计局2006年颁布的《关于统计上划分城乡的暂行规定》计算 — and NEITHER has a publisher's page. NBS's 国家统计标准 listing carries a third, differently-titled document: 《统计上划分城乡的规定》, approved by the State Council as 国函[2008]60号 on 2008-07-12 and effective 2008-08-01 (https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202302/t20230213_1902742.html, read this round). Compared character by character these are three distinct titles — 规定(试行) 1999, 暂行规定 2006, 规定 2008 — and §7a's look-alike rule says compare by characters, never by eye. Wiring either of Guangdong's citations to the 2008 document would be asserting a supersession chain no document in hand states. Both remain nodeless leads: the bar is a publisher's page for the 1999 or the 2006 edition.

NO EDGE — the settled refusal, now recorded for a fourth province. Guangdong's chapter 1 indicators.html carries the standard NBS paragraph 这次修订是在2011年分类标准的基础上，参照联合国《所有经济活动的国际标准产业分类》（2006年，修订第四版，简称ISIC/Rev.4）进行的。 Its SUBJECT is GB/T 4754-2017's derivation, not the yearbook's, the edge already exists first-party off GB/T 4754's own 前言, and the same sentence has been refused for Hubei, Shanghai and Shandong. Recorded so the next round that opens this file does not read it as a new find.

NO EDGE. Guangdong chapter 7's 简要说明 sources its energy material to 全省《地区能源平衡表》《工业企业能源购进、消费及库存表》等 and says 规模以上工业企业的能源消费根据国家统计局制定的报表制度由统计系统搜集资料逐级汇总上报. The bracketed names are TABLE/FORM names inside a reporting system, not the instrument's title, and the only reference to the instrument itself is 国家统计局制定的报表制度 — the agency-not-artefact refusal, §7a's most-cited line. NBS's 统计制度 listing does publish 《能源统计调查制度》, but Guangdong does not name it.

NO EDGE — the bare-title refusal, fourth occurrence. Hunan's zb02, fetched this round as part of the second-layer sweep (round 36 read zb01 only; left.htm lists 19 zbNN.pdf), reads 根据《国民经济行业分类》（GB/T4754-2017）和《三次产业划分规定》 — the standard is named with its number and that edge is already live off zb01, but 《三次产业划分规定》 carries no year. The node now exists (cn-nbs-three-sector-division-2012, this file) — a bare citation still cannot say whether it means the 2012 text or the 2018-revised state, so this stays refused; only a DATED citation reaches the node.

NODELESS LEAD, recorded not refused. Hunan's zb14 (建筑业) names TWO NBS accounting instruments by title: 经济普查年度建筑业增加值按照《经济普查年度GDP核算方案》计算，非经济普查年度建筑业增加值按照《非经济普查年度GDP核算方案》计算。 Read live from http://222.240.193.190/2025tjnj/zk/html/zb14.pdf on 2026-09-09. Both are real NBS methodological instruments and neither has a node or a located publisher's page; the bar is the page, per HANDOFF's nodeless-instrument rule. First citation for both.

CITATION COUNT, not an edge. Hunan's zb15 carries the 民用汽车 definition naming 《机动车注册登记工作规范》 (MPS), and Guangdong's chapter 15 indicators.html and Suzhou's layer were both read this round for the same class. That instrument now has FIVE independent citations (Xi'an zb21, Shandong zb17, Hunan zb15, Guangdong ch15, plus the earlier one) and still no publisher's page — the bar is unchanged and the count is recorded so a later round can see how strong the lead is. Hunan zb15 also names 现行的交通行业《运输货物分类和代码》标准 (MOT), now a third citation, same position.

CITATION COUNT, not an edge. Suzhou's zb16 defines 星级饭店 as 指设备、设施、服务符合《旅游饭店星级的划分与评定》，通过相关旅游管理部门评定，并取得星级饭店称号的饭店. Third citation of an instrument that has no node and no located publisher's page (MCT). Suzhou's zb04 separately names 《企业会计准则》 and 《小企业会计准则》 (财政部) in its fixed-asset definition — the 小企业会计准则 lead round 40 opened off Xi'an now has a second and third citation, since Guangdong's chapter 12 indicators.html names both as well. Same bar: the publisher's own page.
